Study
H2
Explore our dedicated undergraduate and postgraduate biomedical engineering courses. You will learn from and collaborate with world-renowned educators and researchers across many disciplines.
Research
H2
We advance human health through groundbreaking research in engineering, biomedical sciences, and clinical medicine.
Advancing health through research innovation
We advance fundamental concepts, create knowledge from the molecular to the organ level, and develop innovative technologies for disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation—improving health, care, and quality of life.
We deliver inspiring, high-quality education programs at all degree levels to train the next generation of interdisciplinary leaders in biomedical engineering. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and supportive environment that promotes the growth and development of our people.
